title: Legion of Super-Heroes Annual #2 DC 1983 Karate Kid Princess Projectra Wedding
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned. See photos.
descriptionText:
Legion of Super-Heroes Annual #2 (1983), DC Comics - the wedding of Karate Kid (Val Armorr) and Princess Projectra. Written by Paul Levitz, art and cover by Keith Giffen with Larry Mahlstedt. $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: Mattel Intellivision Advanced Dungeons & Dragons cartridge ad.

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
